title: fpengine protocol v1: shared definitions
description: Normative. Building blocks referenced by the other protocol schemas. The .invalid host is an identifier only and is never fetched. Owner: docs/specs/helper.md (WP-201).

protocol_version.description: The protocol version carried by every event. v1 is the only version.

abs_path.description: An absolute, standardised POSIX path as given by the discovering component (contracts.md section 2). Symlinks are not resolved and the helper never rewrites it. No '..' segments.

group_id.description: Script group id, in the fixed GROUPS order (contracts.md section 1).

script_tag.description: An OpenType ScriptList tag exactly as stored in the font (4 printable ASCII characters, e.g. 'latn', 'DFLT', 'dev2').

ranges.description: A code-point set as sorted, non-overlapping, non-adjacent inclusive ranges [[start, end], ...] (catalog/cache.py:_ranges). Sortedness and disjointness are checked by the protocol tests, not by this schema.

embedding.description: OS/2 fsType as the original app's labels (catalog/face.py:_embedding).

stage.description: Progress stage. Forge: validate, plan, prepare, merge, finish, verify, done (contracts.md section 5). Scan: scan.

error_stage.description: The stage an error event is attributed to; null when the request itself was rejected.

error_code.description: Error codes of the terminal error event (contracts.md section 5).

file_error_code.description: Per-file scan error codes (non-terminal file_error event). not_found: the path does not exist; io_error: it exists but cannot be read (permissions, not a regular file, I/O failure); unreadable: it was read but is not a font fontTools can parse; internal: an unexpected failure while reading it.
